exact.From the main search page, you can brows: 在主检索页面上，你可以按以下类别浏览条目：
exact.When browsing search results, each entry: 浏览检索结果时，每个条目都会显示关键信息，帮助你识别并优先关注最相关的结构。
exact.Reviewed vs. Unreviewed entries: Search: 已审核与未审核条目：检索结果会标明某个蛋白质是否已由注释人员人工审核。标记为已审核（Swiss-Prot）的条目已由 UniProt 专家人工整理，其注释（包括功能、序列与变异）已对照文献核实。标记为未审核（TrEMBL）的条目由计算注释，尚未经过人工整理。如果你要找的是研究得比较充分的蛋白质，筛选为只显示已审核条目有助于把结果缩小到注释最可靠的蛋白质。该筛选器位于检索结果页面上。
exact.The search process can take up to 10 min: 检索过程最长可能需要 10 分钟才能完成。如需再次查看、复查或分享结果，你可以复制或收藏结果页面的网址。注意查询必须至少 20 个氨基酸长，且只接受标准残基。
exact.We display a pairwise sequence alignment: 我们会显示两两序列比对：顶行是输入序列，中间行是输入序列查询与数据库中目标序列之间相匹配的氨基酸位置，底行显示目标序列。
exact.Results can be sorted by HSP score (Loca: 结果可按 HSP 分数（在给定检索中达到最高比对分数之一的无空位局部比对）、E 值（查询序列按随机概率预期与 AlphaFold 数据库序列匹配的命中数）、一致性百分比、查询覆盖度（命中序列覆盖查询序列的比例）、目标长度（目标序列中的氨基酸数）或比对长度（输入与目标序列之间比对的氨基酸数）排序。
exact.Coordinate files can be downloaded from: 坐标文件可从结构页右上角的菜单以 mmCIF 或 PDB 格式下载。这些格式被三维结构查看软件广泛支持，例如 PyMOL 与 Chimera。

exact.MSAs for all generated predicted models: 所有已生成预测模型的 MSA 均可从 FTP 区域下载。
exact.Note that the PDB and mmCIF files contai: 注意 PDB 与 mmCIF 文件包含所有区域的坐标，无论其 pLDDT 分数如何。用户需依照上述指引审慎解读模型。
exact.Structure pages for multimers have five: 多聚体的结构页有五个标签页：摘要与模型置信度、大分子、结构域、注释与相似蛋白。摘要与模型置信度标签页显示复合物的基本信息（有 UniProt 数据时取自 UniProt），以及 AlphaFold 预测输出与置信度度量。
exact.TED provides a powerful framework for un: TED 为理解蛋白质结构域如何组织提供了有力框架，是进化、结构与功能研究的有价值资源。
exact.Residue and point mutation annotations a: 残基与点突变注释由 PDBe 开发的基于 AI 的命名实体识别（NER）系统从科学文献中自动识别。该模型基于 PubMedBERT，并通过人在回路流程微调：专家生物注释员先反复标注并校验蛋白质结构文献，之后充当该自动化系统的校对者。
exact.Finally, the experimentally validated an: 最后，PDBe 中经实验验证的注释通过序列一致性匹配转移到 AFDB 中的预测模型。
exact.AlphaMissense is an AI model that builds: AlphaMissense 是一个建立在 Google DeepMind AlphaFold2 之上的 AI 模型，把不同蛋白质中的“错义”突变归为“可能致病”“可能良性”或“不确定”，并给出估计变异致病可能性的分数。AlphaMissense 借助 AlphaFold2 建模蛋白质结构的能力，以及从相关序列学习进化约束的能力。其实现与 AlphaFold2 高度一致，仅有一些架构差异。
exact.Note that AlphaMissense does not predict: 注意 AlphaMissense 不预测突变后蛋白质结构的变化，也不预测稳定性等生物物理性质。它使用相关蛋白质序列与蛋白质结构作为上下文信息来估计致病性。

exact.March 2026: 1,754,199 homodimers derived: 2026 年 3 月：在 NVIDIA 数据集下提供了 1,754,199 个同源二聚体，来自 Swiss-Prot、WHO 清单和模式参考蛋白质组。
exact.May 2026: This release included ~ 2.2M h: 2026 年 5 月：本次发布包含约 220 万个同源与异源二聚体，来自 Uniprot 与 Swiss-Prot 中的 4,777 个蛋白质组，涉及 16 个模式生物和 30 个 WHO 全球健康蛋白质组的蛋白质。
exact.Sep 2026: Added ~1.7 million predictions: 2026 年 9 月：新增约 170 万个病毒蛋白质复合物预测，覆盖约 3,500 个病毒蛋白质组，由国际研究联盟生成；同时纳入 Atkinson 实验室病毒 AlphaFold 数据库（VAD）的条目。本次发布还引入了门户视图，更便于发现 AlphaFold DB 中与全球健康重点研究领域相关的预测，包括大流行病防范、抗微生物药物耐药性、被忽视的热带病和 WHO 全球健康蛋白质组。
exact.The wider UniProt predictions are the ou: 更广泛的 UniProt 预测来自单一模型，而 Swiss-Prot / 蛋白质组条目代表 5 次模型运行中最可信的预测。CASP14 上的内部基准测试表明，用于 UniProt 的模型（“model_2_ptm”）准确度略低（相比五个模型低 1 GDT），且由于只用了一个模型而非从 5 个中挑选，置信度略有偏低（低 1 pLDDT）。

exact.Structural biologists more often express: 结构生物学家更常这样表达两个蛋白质结构的相似性：先对结构做最优叠合，再计算等价残基 Cα 原子之间的均方根距离（RMSD）。取预测最好的 95% 残基上的 RMSD-Cα 中位数，可减弱柔性尾部和晶体堆积伪影的影响。按这一指标，AlphaFold 的 CASP14 预测与实验模型的中位距离为 0.96 Å，次优方法为 2.83 Å。

templates.pat: AlphaFold does not predict the positions of any non-protein components found in experimental structures (such as cofactors, metals, ligands, ions, DNA/RNA, or post-translational modifications). templates.zh: AlphaFold 不预测实验结构中任何非蛋白质组分的位置（如辅因子、金属、配体、离子、DNA/RNA 或翻译后修饰）。不过，AlphaFold 受训预测的是{{1}}的蛋白质结构。因此，在存在离子（如锌结合位点）或辅因子（如与血红素结合相符的侧链构型）时，主链与侧链坐标常常与预期结构一致。

templates.pat: The {{1}} makes it easier to discover AlphaFold protein structure predictions related to key global health research areas. Predictions included in any specific key topic are gathered across all the data in the AlphaFold Database which combines contributions from Google DeepMind and other 3rd-party collaborators. For some sequences, there will be multiple predictions across the database content because different contributors have created the predicted models independently, and each one represents its own hypothesis. For example Bcl-2-like gene 16 protein (UniProt accession Q01001) is found in the data provided by Viro3D, BFVD, Nvidia and Viral AlphaFold Database providing four independent predictions for this protein in the “Pandemic Preparedness Portal”. Also, any particular sequence may be present in more than one portal. For example, some bacterial proteins like those from Staphylococcus aureus will be present under the portal “Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR)” and “WHO Global Health Proteomes” since this pathogen is a major public-health threat due to its antimicrobial resistance.
templates.zh: {{1}}让发现与全球健康重点研究领域相关的 AlphaFold 蛋白质结构预测更加容易。某个主题下的预测汇集了 AlphaFold 数据库中的全部数据，这些数据由 Google DeepMind 及其他第三方合作者共同贡献。对某些序列，数据库内容中会有多个预测，因为不同贡献者各自独立创建了预测模型，每个模型代表其各自的假设。例如 Bcl-2 样基因 16 蛋白（UniProt 登录号 Q01001）出现在 Viro3D、BFVD、Nvidia 和病毒 AlphaFold 数据库提供的数据中，在「大流行病防范门户」中为该蛋白提供了四个独立预测。此外，任一序列可能出现在多个门户中。例如金黄色葡萄球菌等细菌蛋白质会同时出现在「抗微生物药物耐药性（AMR）」和「WHO 全球健康蛋白质组」门户下，因为该病原体因其抗微生物药物耐药性而成为重大公共卫生威胁。

templates.pat: {{1}} Finds proteins relevant to drug resistance and the search for new antimicrobial targets. As taxonomy identifiers from NCBI were used to identify bacterial predictions in the database, sub-species and different strains are also included.
templates.zh: {{1}} 查找与耐药性及新抗菌靶标发现相关的蛋白质。该门户收集的模型覆盖 WHO 全球健康蛋白质组中的细菌蛋白质组，以及来自 UniProt、由 Google DeepMind 和 NVIDIA 折叠的其他细菌蛋白质序列。此外，我们已把 ATBC 的完整预测集加入该门户。由于使用 NCBI 的分类学标识符来识别数据库中的细菌预测，亚种和不同菌株也被纳入。

templates.pat: {{1}} Gives you access to proteins from disease-causing organisms from tropical regions that remain comparatively understudied despite their deleterious impact on human health. Models aggregated into this portal include understudied pathogens from the WHO Global Health Proteomes predicted by Google DeepMind complemented with the kinetoplastid dataset, as well as models from AllTheBacteria, Big Fantastic Virus Database, and Viro3D. Predictions for homo- and heterodimers are provided by NVIDIA.
templates.zh: {{1}} 让你获取来自热带地区致病生物的蛋白质，这些生物尽管对人类健康危害严重，研究仍相对不足。汇聚到该门户的模型包括 Google DeepMind 预测的 WHO 全球健康蛋白质组中的研究不足病原体，并补充了动质体数据集，以及来自 AllTheBacteria、Big Fantastic Virus Database 和 Viro3D 的模型。同源与异源二聚体的预测由 NVIDIA 提供。

templates.pat: {{1}} Browse 30 WHO priority proteomes, providing a proteome-wide view of pathogens with major public-health impact. The predictions for this portal were provided by Google DeepMind, ATBC, VAD and NVIDIA. As models were identified across each dataset using NCBI taxonomy identifiers, there will be sequences that have more than one prediction available, each of them created by providers independently.
templates.zh: {{1}} 浏览 30 个 WHO 优先蛋白质组，从蛋白质组层面了解具有重大公共卫生影响的病原体。该门户的预测由 Google DeepMind、ATBC、VAD 和 NVIDIA 提供。由于使用 NCBI 分类学标识符在各数据集中识别模型，会有序列对应多个可用预测，每个预测均由不同提供方独立创建。

templates.pat: AlphaFold Database sequence-based similarity search is implemented using the Protein Basic Local Alignment Search Tool (BLASTP, see further information here: {{1}}). This tool compares a protein sequence query to the sequences of the predictions in the AlphaFold Database and returns a list of AlphaFold predictions with similar sequences to the one the user provided.
templates.zh: AlphaFold 数据库的基于序列的相似性检索使用蛋白质基本局部比对搜索工具（BLASTP，更多信息见：{{1}}）实现。该工具将蛋白质序列查询与 AlphaFold 数据库中的预测序列比较，返回与用户所提供序列相似的 AlphaFold 预测列表。

templates.pat: {{1}}: Search results indicate whether a protein has been manually reviewed by annotators. Entries labelled {{2}} have been manually curated by UniProt experts, meaning their annotations, including function, sequence, and variants, have been verified against the literature. Entries labelled {{3}} are computationally annotated and have not yet undergone manual curation. If you are looking for a well-characterised protein, filtering to show only Reviewed entries can help narrow your results to the most reliably annotated proteins. This filter is available on the search results page.
templates.zh: {{1}}：检索结果会标明某个蛋白质是否经注释人员人工审核。标为{{2}}的条目已由 UniProt 专家人工整理，意味着其注释（包括功能、序列和变异）已对照文献核实。标为{{3}}的条目由计算注释，尚未经过人工整理。如果你在找研究较充分的蛋白质，筛选只显示已审核条目有助于把结果缩小到注释最可靠的蛋白质。该筛选器在检索结果页上可用。

templates.pat: {{1}}: Each search result includes an overall pLDDT confidence score for the predicted structure. You can use the pLDDT slider on the search results page to restrict results to models above a confidence threshold of your choice. This is particularly useful if you are only interested in high-confidence predictions, for example when planning experimental follow-up. Keep in mind that a lower overall score does not necessarily mean the entire structure is unreliable. Confidence can vary considerably along a chain, and high-confidence regions may still be highly informative even in lower-scoring models. Note, that the scores represent AlphaFold's confidence in the 3D arrangement of the amino acid chain but is not a confidence in the biological correctness of the predicted model.
templates.zh: {{1}}：每条检索结果都包含预测结构的整体 pLDDT 置信度评分。你可以在检索结果页用 pLDDT 滑块把结果限制在你选定的置信度阈值以上。如果你只关注高置信度预测（例如规划后续实验时），这尤其有用。请记住，整体评分较低并不一定意味着整个结构不可靠。置信度沿链可能变化很大，即使模型整体评分较低，高置信度区域仍可能很有参考价值。另请注意，这些评分代表 AlphaFold 对氨基酸链三维排布的置信度，并不代表对预测模型生物学正确性的置信度。

templates.pat: Foldseek is a tool for fast and sensitive protein structure search. It compares protein structures by representing them as sequences over a 3Di alphabet that describes the local tertiary interactions between residues in the structure. This allows Foldseek to efficiently search vast protein structure databases to find similar structures. {{1}}{{2}}For technical details on Foldseek, please refer to the original publication: {{3}}.
templates.zh: Foldseek 是一款快速、灵敏的蛋白质结构检索工具。它通过把蛋白质结构表示为基于 3Di 字母表的序列来比较结构，该字母表描述了结构中残基之间的局部三级相互作用。这使 Foldseek 能高效检索庞大的蛋白质结构数据库，以找到相似结构。{{1}}{{2}}有关 Foldseek 的技术细节，请参阅原始论文：{{3}}。

templates.pat: Collaborating with the {{1}}, we grouped structurally similar proteins into clusters using {{2}}. Our clustering approach was a two-phase process:
templates.zh: 我们与{{1}}合作，使用{{2}}把结构相似的蛋白质归入聚类。我们的聚类方法分两个阶段：

templates.pat: The first phase, AFDB50/MMSeqs2, involved clustering the UniProtKB protein sequences from the AlphaFold Database using {{1}}, with a maximum of 50% sequence identity and a 90% sequence overlap. This reduced dataset was called AFDB50. In the second phase, AFDB/Foldseek, proteins were grouped based on structural similarity. Representatives of each cluster from the first phase were chosen according to the highest pLDDT score. Structural clustering was performed with {{2}}, using a minimum structural alignment overlap of 90% and an E-value cutoff of 0.01.
templates.zh: 第一阶段 AFDB50/MMSeqs2，使用{{1}}对 AlphaFold 数据库中的 UniProtKB 蛋白质序列进行聚类，序列一致性上限为 50%，序列重叠至少 90%。这个缩减后的数据集称为 AFDB50。第二阶段 AFDB/Foldseek，按结构相似性对蛋白质分组。第一阶段每个聚类的代表按最高 pLDDT 评分选取。结构聚类使用{{2}}完成，最小结构比对重叠为 90%，E 值阈值为 0.01。

templates.pat: For more details about the clustering process, please refer to the following paper: {{1}}
templates.zh: 有关聚类流程的更多详情，请参阅以下论文：{{1}}

templates.pat: AlphaFold produces a per-residue estimate of its confidence on a scale from 0 - 100 . This confidence measure is called pLDDT and corresponds to the model’s predicted score on the {{1}}. pLDDT reflects local confidence for each residue, but in complexes it does not by itself indicate whether the relative placement of chains or the predicted interface is correct. It is stored in the B-factor fields of the mmCIF and PDB files available for download (although unlike a B-factor, higher pLDDT is better). pLDDT is also used to colour-code the residues of the model in the 3D structure viewer. The following rules of thumb provide guidance on the expected reliability of a given region:
templates.zh: AlphaFold 会给出逐残基的置信度估计，范围为 0 - 100。该置信度度量称为 pLDDT，对应模型在{{1}}上的预测评分。pLDDT 反映每个残基的局部置信度，但在复合物中，它本身并不能说明链的相对位置或预测界面是否正确。它存储于可下载的 mmCIF 和 PDB 文件的 B 因子字段中（不过与 B 因子不同，pLDDT 越高越好）。pLDDT 还用于在三维结构查看器中为模型残基着色。以下经验规则可帮助判断某区域的预期可靠性：

templates.pat: {{1}} (interface predicted Template Modelling) ranges from 0 to 1 and measures the quality of the predicted interaction between protein chains. While pLDDT measures confidence within an individual chain, ipTM reflects confidence in the predicted relative positions of the subunits in the complex. As a general guide, ipTM > 0.8 indicates a confident, high-quality prediction; ipTM 0.6-0.8 suggests the prediction is uncertain; and ipTM < 0.6 suggests the complex may be incorrect. Please note that disordered regions and regions with low pLDDT can reduce the ipTM score, even when the predicted interaction is biologically meaningful.
templates.zh: {{1}}（界面预测模板建模）取值范围为 0 到 1，衡量蛋白质链之间预测相互作用的质量。pLDDT 衡量单条链内部的置信度，而 ipTM 反映对复合物中各亚基预测相对位置的置信度。一般可参考：ipTM > 0.8 表示预测可信、质量高；ipTM 0.6-0.8 表示预测不确定；ipTM < 0.6 表示复合物可能不正确。请注意，即使预测的相互作用具有生物学意义，无序区域和 pLDDT 较低的区域也会拉低 ipTM 评分。

templates.pat: {{1}} (predicted DockQ score 2) is a modified version of pDockQ ({{2}}). It combines two AlphaFold confidence scores: the average local confidence of the interface residues (pLDDT) and the average confidence of their relative positioning across the interface (PAE). These are combined and then passed through a calibrated sigmoid function to produce a single predicted score. A pDockQ2 value above ~0.23 can be used as a practical guide for a likely acceptable interface. For more details, see: {{3}}.
templates.zh: {{1}}（预测 DockQ 评分 2）是 pDockQ 的改进版本（{{2}}）。它结合两个 AlphaFold 置信度评分：界面残基的平均局部置信度（pLDDT）与它们在界面两侧相对定位的平均置信度（PAE）。二者结合后经校准的 sigmoid 函数处理，得出单一预测评分。pDockQ2 高于约 0.23 可作为界面可能可接受的实用参考。更多详情见：{{3}}。

templates.pat: {{1}}(Local Interaction Score) is calculated from the inter-chain PAE. Residue-residue pairs with PAE <12 Å are retained as the local interaction area, and these retained values are inversely mapped onto a 0-1 scale so that lower PAE gives a higher score. LIS is the average of these inverted values across the interface of the interacting protein pair. Higher LIS values indicate greater confidence in the predicted interaction interface. For more details, see: {{2}}.
templates.zh: {{1}}（局部相互作用评分）由链间 PAE 计算得出。PAE <12 Å 的残基对保留为局部相互作用区域，这些保留值被反向映射到 0-1 量表，使 PAE 越低评分越高。LIS 是相互作用蛋白质对界面上这些反相值的平均值。LIS 越高表示对预测相互作用界面的置信度越高。更多详情见：{{2}}。

templates.pat: {{1}} The displayed values of ipSAE, pDockQ2 and LIS correspond to the maximum values; ipSAEmax, pDockQ2max and LISmax. In addition, although the confidence metrics described above, namely ipTM, ipSAE, pDockQ2 and LIS, typically have theoretical ranges between 0 and 1, the entries displayed on the website are filtered using thresholds of pDockQ2max ≥ 0.23, and ipSAEmax ≥ 0.6 , so they will not span their full theoretical ranges across the entries. In practice, these scores often appear skewed toward higher values because lower-confidence predictions have already been removed by the pDockQ2 and ipSAE filtering step.
templates.zh: {{1}} 显示的 ipSAE、pDockQ2 和 LIS 数值对应最大值，即 ipSAEmax、pDockQ2max 和 LISmax。此外，上述置信度指标（即 ipTM、ipSAE、pDockQ2 和 LIS）的理论范围通常在 0 到 1 之间，但网站上显示的条目已按 pDockQ2max ≥ 0.23 和 ipSAEmax ≥ 0.6 的阈值过滤，因此它们在各条目间不会覆盖完整的理论范围。实践中这些评分常偏向较高值，因为置信度较低的预测已被 pDockQ2 与 ipSAE 过滤步骤移除。

templates.pat: Structure pages for monomers have four tabs: Summary and Model Confidence, Domains, Annotations, and Similar Proteins. The {{1}} tab displays basic information about the protein or complex (drawn from UniProt where available), together with AlphaFold prediction outputs and confidence measures.
templates.zh: 单体结构页有四个标签页：摘要与模型置信度、结构域、注释和相似蛋白。{{1}}标签页显示蛋白质或复合物的基本信息（在可获得时取自 UniProt），以及 AlphaFold 的预测输出和置信度度量。

templates.pat: The second output is a per-residue confidence metric called {{1}}, which is used to colour the residues by AlphaFold's confidence for the prediction. Note, that model confidence can vary greatly along a chain so it is important to consult the confidence estimates when interpreting structural features. The lower confidence bands may be associated with disorder (see our {{2}}).
templates.zh: 第二种输出是称为 {{1}} 的逐残基置信度指标，用于按 AlphaFold 对预测的置信度为残基着色。请注意，模型置信度沿链可能变化很大，因此在解读结构特征时应参考置信度估计。较低的置信度区间可能与无序有关（见我们的{{2}}）。

templates.pat: The third output is Predicted Aligned Error (PAE), which is necessary to assess confidence in the domain packing and large-scale topology of the protein. See the FAQ below on {{1}}.
templates.zh: 第三种输出是预测比对误差（PAE），评估结构域堆积和蛋白质大尺度拓扑的置信度所必需。关于{{1}}，请参阅下方常见问题。

templates.pat: The {{1}} tab displays all structural domains identified in the model by TED ({{2}}). For each domain, key information is shown including its CATH classification, quality score, residue boundaries, length, and average pLDDT. For a full explanation of these fields, see {{3}} below.
templates.zh: {{1}}标签页显示 TED（{{2}}）在模型中识别出的全部结构域。每个结构域显示关键信息，包括其 CATH 分类、质量评分、残基边界、长度和平均 pLDDT。这些字段的完整说明见下方{{3}}。

templates.pat: The {{1}} tab displays another annotation track spanning the full length of the protein sequence. The default annotation displayed is coloured by the previously mentioned {{2}} confidence score, using the same colour scheme representing the four confidence bands. Hovering over any position on the bar reveals the amino acid, its ordinal position and its pLDDT score, while simultaneously highlighting the corresponding residue on the 3D model. The {{3}} button below the pLDDT track toggles this colouring directly onto the structure viewer. The tab also includes a Custom Tracks feature. This allows you to assign your own set of residues to an annotation with a name, and map them onto the annotation track and 3D viewer. This is useful for highlighting any region of interest directly on the structure. For example, a known functional site or a set of residues relevant to your analysis. Each custom track has its own in 3D button to toggle its display on the model independently, and tracks can be managed via the settings icon next to the Custom Tracks label.
templates.zh: {{1}}标签页显示另一条覆盖蛋白质序列全长的注释轨道。默认显示的注释按前述 {{2}} 置信度评分着色，采用表示四个置信度区间的同一配色方案。将鼠标悬停在条上的任意位置，会显示氨基酸、其序号位置及其 pLDDT 评分，同时在三维模型上高亮对应残基。pLDDT 轨道下方的{{3}}按钮可将该着色直接切换到结构查看器上。该标签页还提供自定义轨道功能，允许你为一组自选残基指定名称并添加注释，再将其映射到注释轨道和三维查看器。这对于直接在结构上高亮任何感兴趣区域很有用，例如已知的功能位点或与分析相关的一组残基。每条自定义轨道都有各自的「三维中」按钮，可独立控制其在模型上的显示；轨道可通过「自定义轨道」标签旁的设置图标管理。

templates.pat: For human canonical proteins, the Annotations tab additionally displays an {{1}}, showing the predicted pathogenicity of all possible single amino acid substitutions across the sequence, coloured from likely benign (blue) to likely pathogenic (red). An {{2}} button maps the selected colouring onto the structure viewer. See {{3}}
templates.zh: 对人类规范蛋白质，「注释」标签页还会显示{{1}}，展示整个序列上所有可能的单氨基酸替换的预测致病性，颜色从可能良性（蓝色）到可能致病（红色）。{{2}}按钮会把所选着色映射到结构查看器上。参见{{3}}

templates.pat: The {{1}} tab allows the discovery of structurally similar proteins across multiple databases using Foldseek. Results are organised by database, including the {{2}}, the AlphaFold Database clustered to 50% sequence identity (AFDB50), {{3}}, {{4}}, {{5}}, and {{6}}. The number of hits found in each database is shown on its tab. Selecting a tab displays the results from that database only.
templates.zh: {{1}}标签页可使用 Foldseek 在多个数据库中发掘结构相似的蛋白质。结果按数据库组织，包括{{2}}、按 50% 序列一致性聚类的 AlphaFold 数据库（AFDB50）、{{3}}、{{4}}、{{5}} 和 {{6}}。每个数据库找到的命中数显示在其标签上。选择某个标签只显示该数据库的结果。

templates.pat: For each hit, the table displays the entry ID and chain, protein description, species, aligned residue range, E-value, sequence identity, and resolution where available. Results can be filtered by species using the search box, and the full dataset for each tab can be downloaded via the {{1}} data option. For more information, see {{2}}
templates.zh: 对每个命中，表格显示条目 ID 与链、蛋白质描述、物种、比对残基区间、E 值、序列一致性以及（在可获得时）分辨率。可使用检索框按物种过滤结果，每个标签页的完整数据集可通过{{1}}数据选项下载。更多信息见{{2}}

templates.pat: Each hit can be superimposed onto the 3D viewer individually using the {{1}} toggle, enabling direct visual comparison between the AlphaFold model and the similar structure. The user interface allows hits from multiple databases to be aligned simultaneously onto the query protein. The viewer can be coloured by pLDDT to retain confidence information during the comparison. Aligned coordinates can also be downloaded in mmCIF format for use in external structure viewing or analysis software.
templates.zh: 每个命中都可通过{{1}}开关单独叠合到三维查看器上，从而直接在 AlphaFold 模型与相似结构之间做视觉比较。用户界面支持把多个数据库的命中同时比对到查询蛋白质上。查看器可按 pLDDT 着色，以便在比较过程中保留置信度信息。对齐后的坐标也可按 mmCIF 格式下载，供外部结构查看或分析软件使用。

templates.pat: Below the similar structures results, the tab also includes a {{1}} section, which shows other AlphaFold database entries that cluster with your protein. This is provided by AFDB Clusters and is presented across two tabs:
templates.zh: 在相似结构结果下方，该标签页还包含{{1}}区块，显示与你的蛋白质聚为同一类的其他 AlphaFold 数据库条目。该功能由 AFDB Clusters 提供，分两个标签页呈现：

templates.pat: {{1}} — clustered using MMseqs2 based on sequence similarity. Each cluster contains sequences sharing a maximum of 50% sequence identity and at least 90% bi-directional sequence overlap with the longest sequence of the cluster representative.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 基于序列相似性使用 MMseqs2 聚类。每个聚类中的序列与聚类代表的最长序列最多共享 50% 序列一致性，且双向序列重叠至少 90%。

templates.pat: {{1}} — clustered using Foldseek based on structural similarity. Each cluster contains structures meeting an E-value threshold below 0.01 and at least 90% bi-directional structural overlap with the largest structure of the cluster representative.
templates.zh: {{1}} —— 基于结构相似性使用 Foldseek 聚类。每个聚类中的结构满足 E 值阈值低于 0.01，且与聚类代表的最大结构双向结构重叠至少 90%。

templates.pat: Each tab lists the AFDB accession, protein description, species, sequence length, and average pLDDT of cluster members, sorted by average pLDDT by default. For more information see {{1}}.
templates.zh: 每个标签页列出聚类成员的 AFDB 登录号、蛋白质描述、物种、序列长度和平均 pLDDT，默认按平均 pLDDT 排序。更多信息见{{1}}。

templates.pat: Structure pages for multimers have five tabs: Summary and Model Confidence, Macromolecules, Domains, Annotations, and Similar Proteins. The {{1}} tab displays basic information about the complex (drawn from UniProt where available), together with AlphaFold prediction outputs and confidence measures.
templates.zh: 多聚体结构页有五个标签页：摘要与模型置信度、大分子、结构域、注释和相似蛋白。{{1}}标签页显示复合物的基本信息（在可获得时取自 UniProt），以及 AlphaFold 的预测输出和置信度度量。

templates.pat: For multimers, interface quality scores are also displayed — ipSAE, ipTM, pDockQ2, and LIS — which provide complementary assessments of the reliability of the predicted interaction between chains. See the FAQs below for guidance on how to interpret these {{1}}.
templates.zh: 对多聚体，还会显示界面质量评分——ipSAE、ipTM、pDockQ2 和 LIS——它们从不同侧面评估链间预测相互作用的可靠性。关于如何解读这些{{1}}，请参阅下方常见问题。

templates.pat: The {{1}} tab provides detailed information for each distinct protein in the complex. Selecting a protein from the sidebar on the left displays its gene name, source organism, UniProt accession, and biological function (drawn from UniProt). It also shows how many other complexes in the AFDB this protein appears in as a component, and links to any available experimental structures in PDBe-KB. The corresponding amino acid sequence, PAE matrix, and 3D viewer are displayed below. {{2}}, {{3}} and {{4}} tabs are currently not available.
templates.zh: {{1}}标签页提供复合物中每种不同蛋白质的详细信息。从左侧边栏选择某个蛋白质，会显示其基因名、来源物种、UniProt 登录号和生物学功能（取自 UniProt）。它还会显示该蛋白质作为组分出现在 AFDB 中多少个其他复合物里，并链接到 PDBe-KB 中可用的实验结构。下方显示对应的氨基酸序列、PAE 矩阵和三维查看器。{{2}}、{{3}} 和 {{4}} 标签页目前不可用。

templates.pat: AlphaMissense was used to classify the effects of all possible 216 million single amino acid sequence substitutions across the 19,233 {{1}} human proteins.
templates.zh: AlphaMissense 被用于对 19,233 个{{1}}人类蛋白质中所有可能的 2.16 亿个单氨基酸序列替换进行分类。

templates.pat: For more information about AlphaMissense, please refer to the paper: {{1}}
templates.zh: 关于 AlphaMissense 的更多信息，请参阅论文：{{1}}

templates.pat: AlphaMissense scores for all human missense variants are available on the {{1}}{{2}}
templates.zh: 所有人类错义变异的 AlphaMissense 评分可在{{1}}上获取{{2}}

templates.pat: Heatmap data. This file contains the scores estimating the likelihood of pathogenicity and classifications for each possible amino acid substitution within the protein. This file is used to visualise the heatmap you see on the entry pages. {{1}}Column am_class categorises the mutation based on the score:
templates.zh: 热图数据。该文件包含估计蛋白质内每个可能氨基酸替换的致病可能性与分类的评分，用于可视化你在条目页上看到的热图。{{1}}am_class 列根据评分对突变进行分类：

templates.pat: For more information please refer to the paper: {{1}}
templates.zh: 更多信息请参阅论文：{{1}}

templates.pat: {{1}} This number indicates the order in which a domain appears in the protein sequence, starting from the N-terminal residue.
templates.zh: {{1}} 该编号表示结构域在蛋白质序列中出现的顺序，从 N 端残基开始计数。

templates.pat: {{1}} These identifiers classify a protein domain based on its 3D structure. They consist of up to four numbers separated by dots. The last two levels represent Topology/fold ( 3-level C.A.T, e.g. 2.60.400) and Homologous Superfamily (4-level C.A.T.H, e.g. 2.60.40.10). {{2}} In addition, domains without classification labels indicate no similarity to CATH domains used during TED’s classification workflow. For more information, refer to the paper: {{3}}
templates.zh: {{1}} 这些标识符基于三维结构对蛋白质结构域分类。它们由最多四个以点分隔的数字组成。最后两级分别表示拓扑/折叠（3 级 C.A.T，如 2.60.400）和同源超家族（4 级 C.A.T.H，如 2.60.40.10）。{{2}} 此外，没有分类标签的结构域表示与 TED 分类流程所用的 CATH 结构域没有相似性。更多信息请参阅论文：{{3}}

templates.pat: {{1}} These residue ranges define the start and end positions of all segments within a TED Domain. Protein domains are not always continuous stretches of sequence; they can consist of multiple, separated segments.
templates.zh: {{1}} 这些残基区间定义 TED 结构域内所有片段的起止位置。蛋白质结构域不总是连续的序列片段，可能由多个分离片段组成。

templates.pat: {{1}} The total number of residues in all the segments of a domain. Insertions between segments are not included.
templates.zh: {{1}} 结构域内所有片段的残基总数，不包含片段之间的插入部分。

templates.pat: {{1}} The average pLDDT score for residues in a domain. Insertions between segments are excluded. pLDDT is a measure of local confidence in the AlphaFold prediction for that domain.
templates.zh: {{1}} 结构域内残基的平均 pLDDT 评分，不包含片段之间的插入部分。pLDDT 衡量 AlphaFold 对该结构域预测的局部置信度。

templates.pat: To ensure reliability, only residue mentions with sequence positions and point mutations are processed further. These annotations are first validated against experimentally determined protein structures in the Protein Data Bank (PDB) and then mapped to UniProt reference sequences using the SIFTS (Structure Integration with Function, Taxonomy, and Sequence) resource. For more details read the paper here: {{1}}. The validated annotations from PDB are subsequently displayed in AlphaFold DB alongside predicted protein structures, allowing users to explore experimentally supported evidence describing the functional importance of individual residues and mutations.
templates.zh: 为确保可靠性，只有带序列位置和点突变的残基提及才会进入后续处理。这些注释首先对照蛋白质数据库（PDB）中实验测定的蛋白质结构进行验证，然后使用 SIFTS（结构、功能、分类学与序列整合）资源映射到 UniProt 参考序列。更多详情请在此阅读论文：{{1}}。来自 PDB 的经验证注释随后与预测蛋白质结构一起显示在 AlphaFold DB 中，让用户可以查看描述单个残基与突变功能重要性的、有实验支持的证据。

templates.pat: Residue and point mutation annotations are identified using an AI-based named entity recognition (NER) system built on the PubMedBERT transformer model and fine-tuned specifically on structural biology literature. Developed using a human-in-the-loop approach, expert PDBe biocurators iteratively annotated and corrected publications to improve the model. The final model achieved an overall precision of 0.90, recall of 0.92, and an F1 score of 0.91. For more details, refer to the paper: {{1}}
templates.zh: 残基与点突变注释由基于 PubMedBERT 变换器模型构建、并专门在结构生物学文献上微调的 AI 命名实体识别（NER）系统识别。该系统采用人在回路的方法开发，PDBe 的专家生物策展人反复标注并修正文献以改进模型。最终模型的总体精确率为 0.90、召回率为 0.92、F1 分数为 0.91。更多详情请参阅论文：{{1}}

templates.pat: Residue mentions with explicit sequence numbers and point mutations are processed further. Residues are first validated against experimentally determined structures in the Protein Data Bank (PDB) and then mapped to UniProt reference sequences using the SIFTS (Structure Integration with Function, Taxonomy, and Sequence) framework, for more details read the paper here: {{1}}. These experimentally supported annotations are displayed alongside AlphaFold predictions, linking predicted structures to literature describing residue function, interactions, and experimentally observed mutations.
templates.zh: 带有明确序列编号和点突变的残基提及会进入后续处理。残基首先对照蛋白质数据库（PDB）中实验测定的结构进行验证，然后使用 SIFTS（结构、功能、分类学与序列整合）框架映射到 UniProt 参考序列；更多详情请在此阅读论文：{{1}}。这些有实验支持的注释与 AlphaFold 预测一起显示，把预测结构与描述残基功能、相互作用及实验观察到的突变的文献关联起来。

templates.pat: {{1}}: The PAE value of the residue pair, rounded to the closest integer. For the PAE value at position {{2}} is the residue on which the structure is aligned, {{3}} is the residue on which the error is predicted.
templates.zh: {{1}}：残基对的 PAE 值，四舍五入到最接近的整数。对于位置 {{2}} 处的 PAE 值，是结构对齐所依据的残基，{{3}} 是预测误差所针对的残基。
